name: NIST/ARPA-E Adsorbent Database (ISODB)
description: Free, continuously updated NIST database of experimentally measured gas/vapor adsorption isotherms curated from the literature: ~37,700 isotherms across ~8,265 adsorbent materials and 449 adsorbates from ~4,367 articles, digitized from published tables/figures plus interlaboratory reference isotherms.

name: ReSpecTh (Reaction Kinetics, Spectroscopy, Thermochemistry)
description: Open combustion-kinetics data collection (ELTE Budapest): >162,000 experimental data points in >3,600 machine-readable XML files covering ignition delay times (shock tube, RCM), laminar flame speeds, concentration profiles and direct rate coefficients, plus bundled reaction mechanisms.
associated_paper: Varga, Zsely, Turanyi et al., 'ReSpecTh', Sci. Data (2025)

name: MoNA - MassBank of North America
description: Metadata-centric, auto-curating mass-spectra repository (UC Davis Fiehn Lab) with >200,000 spectral records aggregated from experimental reference libraries, in-silico libraries and user contributions; the experimental portion is the majority (hence mixed).

name: GNPS - Global Natural Products Social Molecular Networking
description: Open community platform and reference spectral library for tandem MS of natural products and metabolomics (UCSD): ~2.9 million experimental MS/MS spectra, community-contributed and curated, supporting molecular networking and continuous reanalysis.

name: NanoMine / MaterialsMine
description: Open FAIR knowledge graph of polymer nanocomposite data (Duke/RPI/Northwestern): experimental structure-property data from >1,700 nanocomposite samples extracted from the literature and contributed by labs, with microstructure characterization.
associated_paper: Brinson et al., 'NanoMine: A Knowledge Graph for Nanocomposite Materials Science', ISWC 2020

name: Membrane Database - Polymer Gas Separation (MSA/CSIRO)
description: Database of experimentally measured polymer gas-separation permeabilities covering ~1,500 polymers with permeability/selectivity for N2, O2, H2, CH4 and CO2 compiled from the literature (1950-2018); underpins Robeson upper-bound analysis.

name: NREL/NASA Battery Failure Databank
description: Open database of Li-ion cell abuse-test results (NREL + NASA): hundreds of thermal-runaway tests (nail penetration, thermal, internal short) measured with fractional thermal runaway calorimetry, including heat/mass-ejection fractions and high-speed synchrotron radiography.
associated_paper: Finegan et al., J. Power Sources 597, 234106 (2024)

name: opXRD - Open Experimental Powder XRD Database
description: Open experimental powder X-ray diffraction database aggregating patterns from 18+ labs (KIT AiMat and collaborators): 92,552 measured diffractograms (2,179 phase-labeled) across many materials classes, on Zenodo under CC-BY-4.0 for training/benchmarking ML on real XRD data.
associated_paper: Hollarek et al., 'opXRD', Adv. Intelligent Discovery (2026); arXiv:2503.05577

name: HMDB - Human Metabolome Database
description: Reference resource for human metabolites: HMDB 5.0 holds ~220,945 metabolite entries with >19,700 experimentally measured concentrations plus experimental and predicted MS/NMR reference spectra (mixed: measured concentrations/spectra alongside predicted).
associated_paper: Wishart et al., 'HMDB 5.0', Nucleic Acids Res. 50, D622 (2022)

name: Polymer Property Predictor and Database (NIST/CHiMaD)
description: NIST/CHiMaD resource (UChicago) curating experimentally measured Flory-Huggins interaction parameters and glass-transition temperatures extracted from the literature, with tools to predict polymer phase diagrams.

name: CatTestHub
description: Open benchmarking database of experimental heterogeneous catalysis (Univ. Minnesota): initial release compiles >250 experimental data points over 24 solid catalysts for 3 probe chemistries with harmonized conditions, reactor configuration and characterization.

name: Chemotion Repository
description: Curated open research-data repository for chemistry (KIT; NFDI4Chem): preserves experimental data from syntheses and analytical measurements (NMR, IR, MS, chromatography) for molecules and reactions, ELN-linked with automated plausibility checks; thousands of curated samples/reactions.
associated_paper: Tremouilhac et al., Chemistry-Methods (2021); Nat. Protoc. (2024)

name: RADAR4Chem
description: Free multidisciplinary repository for publishing FAIR chemistry research data (FIZ Karlsruhe; NFDI4Chem), for datasets that don't fit discipline-specific repositories (up to 10 GB/project). Predominantly experimental deposits; accepts all data types (mixed).

name: eNanoMapper / NanoCommons Knowledge Base
description: EU nanoinformatics resource for nanosafety: experimental physicochemical and (eco)toxicological characterization for >1,400 nanomaterials aggregated from projects (nanoMILE, NanoFASE, SmartNanoTox) with harmonized metadata.
